'''Reading ''ter'angreal''''' is a [[Talent]] regarding the ability to discern the purpose and characteristics of a ''[[ter'angreal]]''.

This ability appears to require physical contact with the ''ter'angreal''. [[Elayne Trakand]] first identifies this [[Talent]] in [[Aviendha]], who identified several ''ter'angreal'' recovered from [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|11|15}}
